title: IdeaSeek figure render report (figure-render-v1)
description: Structural contract for the FigureRenderReport that src/paper/render-figures.ts renderFigures returns and `paper render-figures` persists to reports/paper/figure-render.json; `paper review-figure` later rewrites figures[].review in place. Checked structurally: the honest tri-state status, that every figure entry carries both verdicts and the digest trail the report exists to produce (id, ok, outputs, scriptSha256, review, error), and a review block with its append-only history. Left in the domain module on purpose: which figures share bytes (the duplicate-digest demotion to partial), whether a vector output exists, timeout and exit-code reading, and every sha256 computation. Deliberately loose: formats/caption/statistics are written today but copy plan fields that are optional upstream, so they are typed and not required; durationMs is per-figure wall clock that no reader indexes, so it is left unconstrained; outputs[].path takes no pattern because it is `figures/<name>` for scanned files and the script's own savefig string for declared targets; caption and statistics fall back to '' and []; unchanged appears only on the success path.
